description: This Java source file defines the HibernateSerializedObjectDAO class, which implements the SerializedObjectDAO interface. It provides Hibernate-specific database access methods for serialized OpenMRS objects, including retrieval, saving, serialization, deserialization, and management of supported object types.

classes.name: HibernateSerializedObjectDAO
classes.description: Hibernate-specific implementation of SerializedObjectDAO for managing serialized OpenMRS objects using Hibernate ORM.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of HibernateSerializedObjectDAO.

methods.name: getSerializedObject
methods.description: Retrieves a SerializedObject by its ID.

methods.name: getObject
methods.description: Retrieves an OpenmrsObject of a specific class by its ID.

methods.name: getSerializedObjectByUuid
methods.description: Fetches a SerializedObject by its UUID.

methods.name: getObjectByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves an OpenmrsObject by its class and UUID.

methods.name: getAllSerializedObjectsByName
methods.description: Gets a list of SerializedObjects matching a name, with optional exact match.

methods.name: getAllObjectsByName
methods.description: Gets a list of OpenmrsObjects matching a name, with optional exact match.

methods.name: getAllSerializedObjects
methods.description: Retrieves all SerializedObjects of a particular type, optionally including retired ones.

methods.name: getAllObjects
methods.description: Retrieves all OpenmrsObjects of a specific type, optionally including retired ones.

methods.name: saveObject
methods.description: Serializes and saves an OpenmrsObject using the specified serializer.

methods.name: purgeObject
methods.description: Deletes a SerializedObject by its ID.

methods.name: registerSupportedType
methods.description: Registers a new OpenmrsObject subclass as supported for serialization.

methods.name: unregisterSupportedType
methods.description: Removes a class from the supported types list.

methods.name: getRegisteredTypeForObject
methods.description: Returns the registered class type for a given OpenmrsObject.

methods.name: convertSerializedObject
methods.description: Deserializes a SerializedObject into an OpenmrsObject of the specified class.

methods.name: setSessionFactory
methods.description: Assigns the Hibernate SessionFactory used for database operations.

methods.name: getSupportedTypes
methods.description: Gets the list of registered supported OpenmrsObject types.
